'WE APPEAL FOR UNITY, COMPASSION AND DISCIPLINE'

Ito ang panawagan ng Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) kasunod ng mga ikakasang rally sa Nov. 16-18 at Nov. 30.

"Our soldiers perform their duties with professionalism, unity, and full respect for civilian authority," ayon kay AFP Chief of Staff Romeo Brawner, Jr.

"We call on organizers and participants to help uphold their commitment to peaceful conduct. Your cooperation is essential in preventing any attempt by infiltrators or outside elements to take advantage of these events for unlawful purposes," dagdag pa niya.

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 1 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Shear Line
Issued at: 9:19 AM, 15 November 2025(Saturday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon(General Nakar, Panukulan, Burdeos, Polillo), Bulacan(Norzagaray, San Jose del Monte, Angat, Pandi, Balagtas, Santa Maria, Bocaue, Plaridel, Guiguinto, Bustos, Baliuag, Pulilan, San Rafael, San Ildefonso) and Rizal(Rodriguez, Antipolo, San Mateo).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Laguna(Cavinti, Paete, Kalayaan, Pagsanjan, Pakil, Mabitac, Santa Maria, Siniloan, Famy, Pangil, Lumban, San Pedro, Binan, Santa Rosa, Cabuyao, Calamba, Victoria, Calauan, Bay, Los Banos, Pila, Santa Cruz, Magdalena, Liliw) and Cavite(Silang, Carmona, Dasmarinas, Imus, Bacoor, Noveleta, General Trias, Kawit, Gen. Mariano Alvarez, Trece Martires, Tanza, Rosario, Cavite City, Naic, Amadeo, Indang) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Pampanga, Quezon(Infanta, Patnanungan, Jomalig), Rizal(Tanay, Baras, Morong, Teresa, Binangonan, Cardona, Angono, Taytay, Cainta), Bulacan(Dona Remedios Trinidad, Meycauayan, Marilao, Obando, Bulakan, Malolos, Paombong, Hagonoy, Calumpit, San Miguel), Metro Manila(Marikina, Caloocan, Valenzuela, Malabon, Navotas, Manila, Quezon City, Pasig, Taguig, Makati, Mandaluyong, San Juan), Bataan(Hermosa, Dinalupihan, Morong) and Zambales(Subic, San Marcelino, San Narciso, San Felipe, Castillejos, San Antonio, Olongapo) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 12:04 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

data.text:
Hinikayat ng One Bangsamoro Movement (1BANGSA) ang mga Muslim na makibahagi sa tatlong araw na kilos-protesta na gaganapin sa EDSA People Power Monument mula sa Linggo, Nobyembre 16, hanggang Martes, Nobyembre 18.

Ayon sa anunsyo nila sa kanilang Facebook page nitong Biyernes, Nobyembre 14, sa pangunguna ng kanilang National President na si Maulana “Alan” A. Balangi, nananawagan sila sa mga kapwa Muslim na makiisa sa gaganaping malawang protest.

Layunin ng nasabing aktibidad na ipahayag ang panawagan para sa kapayapaan at pagkakaisa kaugnay sa lumalalang isyu ng korapsyon at katiwalian sa pamahalaan.

“Huwag ipagwalang-bahala ang aming tinig, sapagkat kapag ang higit sa sampung (10) milyong Muslim sa Pilipinas ay sabay-sabay na sumigaw ng hustisya, yayanig ang buong bansa mula Sulu hanggang Aparri,” saad nila.

“Ang aming tinig ay hindi tinig ng galit, kundi tinig ng pagmamahal sa Inang Bayan at ng panawagang ibalik ang tiwala sa pamahalaan.” dagdag pa nito. (Via Brit Cezar)
